title: C482/760/2014 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Dr. Shiv Kumar Baranwal AND OTHERS

paras.text:
C482 No. 760 of 2014
Hon'ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. Dinesh Chauhan, Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand/applicant.
Let fresh steps be taken for service upon
the unserved respondents within two weeks.
List this matter after service report is
received.
